description: Data Used for EDeMOS (Electricity Demand Mapping from Open-Source Data): Kenya Case Study is a data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Zenodo. The information in this repository pertains to the Kenya case study for EDeMOS. EDeMOS is an open-source methodology designed for analyzing electricity consumption at a spatially detailed level in any geography. References. A high-resolution gridded dataset to assess electrification in sub-Saharan Africa Falchetta, G., Pachauri, S., Parkinson, S. et al. Coverage: Kenya. The portal files it under the publisher Zenodo. Its tags are energy modelling, Electricity consumption, DHS, Kenya, GIS. The repository dates the deposit 2025; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and electrification planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
